title: Primary living space can accommodate 3.8 m x 3.8 m (R30-R60)
text: Each dwelling is to have one room that is the designated primary living space and for development in areas coded R30 to R60, this primary living space can accommodate a dimension of at least 3.8m x 3.8m¹ (refer Figure 2.1a). ¹Exclusive of built-in cabinetry along walls.
notes: new: no Chapter 3 equivalent (Chapter 3 2.1 has no living-room dimension). Heading 'Primary living space (applies to R30-R60 only)'; no equivalent at R10-R25, as now. Dimension exclusive of built-in cabinetry along walls (footnote 1). Tested on the apartment with the smallest primary living space dimension.
